senses.gloss: (denom. of מַכּוֹשׁ I) to weed; to lop.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 2:5">Kil. II, 5</cite> <he>אין מחייבין אותו לנַכֵּשׁ</he> the law does not bind him to pluck out (the plants which grow among the fenugrec).

<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 2:5">Ib.</cite> <he>ואם נִכֵּשׁ</he> (Y. ed. <he>ני׳</he>) but if he did &c. Tosef. ib. I, 15 <he>והמְנַכֵּשׁ</he> and he who does the weeding (in a field of mixed seeds); <cite ref="Moed Katan 2b">M. Kat. 2ᵇ</cite>; a. fr. [<cite ref="Bava Batra 54a">B. Bath. 54ᵃ</cite> Ms. R., v. <cite ref="M01365"><he>מַכּוֹשׁ</he> I</cite>.]
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 30b">B. Mets. 30ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 88a">B. Bath. 88ᵃ</cite> <he>הִבִּישָׁהּ</he> if he struck the lost beast which he took in charge.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 30">Gen. R. s. 30</cite>, beg. <he>הִכִּישׁוֹ ארי וכ׳</he> a lion struck and crippled him.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 78a">B. Mets. 78ᵃ</cite> <he>הִכִּישָׁהּ נחש</he> a serpent bit her.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 23b:9">B. Kam. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>מַכִּישׁ</he> (Ms. H. <cite ref="M02878"><he>משיך</he></cite>) he who caused a neighbor’s death by bringing the serpent’s tooth in contact with his neighbor’s body; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 78a">Snh. 78ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 944:8">Yalk. Deut. 944</cite> <he>שמַכִּישִׁין</he>, v. <cite ref="S00436"><he>קונטרינים</he></cite>; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 317:5">Sifré Deut. 317</cite> <he>שמכינים</he> (corr. acc.).

senses.gloss: (denom. of מַכּוֹשׁ I) to insert the hoe or spade.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 54a">B. Bath. 54ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M01365"><he>מַכּוֹשׁ</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45">Gen. R. s. 45</cite> <he>הקוצים … לא מִתְנַכְּשִׁין ולא נזרעין וכ׳</he> for thorns there is neither hoeing (digging over) nor sowing, but they grow of themselves, while wheat &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 79:3">Yalk. ib. 79</cite> <he>לא נִכּוֹשִׁין ולא נחרשים וכ׳</he> neither digging, nor ploughing, nor sowing &c.
